summary: More inventory fields: verbosity (Normal to Verbose/Debug) and Limit (host or group pattern) for constructed inventories, Prevent instance group fallback for standard inventories (set via API for smart inventories), and Variables in JSON or YAML (Source variables configure the constructed inventory plugin and create groups).
